name: Toast / Background Sync
description: Background Sync product scenario for the Toast component.

props.title: Sync is taking longer than expected
props.description: You can keep working while the remaining records are processed.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Main line of the notification, in bold.

controls.name: action
controls.description: A button under the text; clicking it runs its onClick and then calls onClose.

controls.name: tone
controls.description: Border color: neutral, positive, warning or destructive; every tone is announced as a polite status. Default: neutral.

controls.name: closable
controls.description: Lets the user close the toast: a close button, and Escape inside the toast; both need `onClose`. Default: true.
